counts_basis: engine/legal_scope.js in-scope set; out-of-scope entities are excluded from every bucket rather than counted as COULD-NOT-STAGE

carrier_derivation.ability: a legal species with the ability in any slot
carrier_derivation.move: a legal species whose learnset (prevo chain + base forme, as learnsMove walks it) lists it; Struggle is carried by every legal species because the authority assigns it without a learnset
carrier_derivation.item: a mega stone by its base species; an itemUser item by one of its users; any other item by any legal species

reds.why: the mega transformation is skipped — the choice is still made and still accepted, so only the FORME goes missing
the status cure is skipped — the berry is still held
the resist berry stops halving anything — it is still held, still read, and the multiplier is dropped
the item stops scaling the drain heal — the damage and the drain both still happen
the type-scoped item multiplier is dropped entirely
the accuracy modifier row is dropped, so every holder reads as untabled
the item speed multiplier is dropped from the speed used to order the turn
the duration extension is dropped and the base length is written instead
the super-effective damage multiplier is dropped

the CHANCE half of the survival is dropped. An item whose survival is unconditional (Focus Sash, `chance == null`) still holds, so a flip here is this item's own and not the shared floor `item/hp-floor` already demonstrates
the HP floor stops holding the body up — the item is still held and still read
the bolted-on flinch is skipped — the item is still held, still read, and its own no-stacking clause is left standing
the passive heal is skipped — the item is still held and still on the board
the flat damage multiplier is dropped; the self-cost is left alone, so a break that moves only the target's HP is the localisation
the species-locked stat multiplier is dropped — the item is still held and still read
the volatile cure is skipped
the category-scoped base-power multiplier is dropped (it is a hardcoded NAME check in the simulator, not a tag read — see the rule comment)
the threshold heal is skipped
the item half of the fractional-priority loop is dropped, so the holder never jumps its bracket; the ABILITY half (Quick Draw) is left standing
the ITEM's crit-stage contribution is dropped, so the holder never reaches the certain tier; the move, ability and volatile contributions are left standing
the after-attack heal is dropped — the attack still lands for the same damage
the stat restoration is skipped
